title: Chapter 110 Ghoul
content:
Chapter 110 Ghoul

Wu Qing's clone finished handling the affairs of Daxia Territory and returned to the Zerg territory. Now the outside world does not need his appearance for the time being. It happened that the Zerg territory encountered some problems and needed the help of the clone.

Since the Zerg territory became the dark territory of Daxia Territory, it has been protected by the rules of the world and has always been peaceful.

The weirdness that occurs at night is similar to that of the Great Xia Territory. Every night, the Zerg can generate several waves of weirdness through bait.

But Wu Qing will not forget that there was once a terrifying existence outside the Zerg territory, and he mobilized various strange creatures to attack the nascent Zerg base.

He also came to Wu Qing on time every night, wanting to pollute Wu Qing. Without the protection of world rules, the Zerg territory could not stop this invasion.

The Zerg territory now has the effect of being protected by the lord, and ordinary weirdness cannot enter, and the terrifying existence seems to have disappeared, but this does not mean that creatures from this world cannot enter.

The Zerg encountered something threatening when they were digging and developing underground bases.

When Wu Qing saw these things from the perspective of the Zerg, he felt that they were a bit like the legendary ghouls.

They are humanoid monsters, more than two meters tall, with lean torsos like hard bones wrapped in gelatinous muscle skin, and terrifying bald heads with large mouths full of sharp teeth.

Their limbs are long and slender, and their sharp claws are like sharp sickles, making people frightened at first sight.

Like the Zerg, they are good at digging and digging holes. They are organized and disciplined, and have a certain IQ. The most important thing is that they are not weird and can directly enter the Zerg territory!

They dug holes and built nests in the ground near the Zerg territory, breeding in terrifying numbers. If the Zerg hadn't developed underground, their existence would not have been discovered for a while.

"Is this a creature that originally existed in this area? Or is it a new thing created by the unknown being after discovering that bugs are ineffective against the Zerg?"

Wu Qing couldn't guess the origin of this creature. He also asked Meng and Wu Cong, and they both said that they had never seen similar creatures or heard anyone mention them specifically.

Because there are weird things in this world, there are too many weird things, and they are not very common things, and generally there are no clear records.

Since no one knew what they were, Wu Qing named them ghouls, and they were indeed very similar to the fictional ghouls in Wu Qing's impression.

The first encounter between the Zerg and the ghoul was when a worker bee dug through the ghoul's underground passage and attracted a ghoul.

When the two sides met, it was a fight. Fortunately, the worker bees were thick-skinned, not small in size, and had certain fighting abilities, so they could protect themselves for the time being.

When the reinforcements from both sides arrived, there was no communication at all, and an underground battle started in the underground passage.

Due to the limitations of the environment, there are not many Zerg puppies and ghouls in head-to-head confrontation, but they all have brutal and primitive fighting styles. It can be regarded as meeting a good talent and meeting an opponent.

The puppy's blade arm and the ghoul's claws kept waving, attacking the opponent's gelatinous skin and hard carapace fiercely. Both sides seemed to feel that such attacks were not efficient enough, so they also used their terrifying big mouths. .

Zerg puppies have biological decomposition liquid in their mouths, which is extremely destructive. Not to be outdone, ghouls also have corrosive liquid in their mouths, which can cause additional damage.

The two sides were like bloodthirsty primitive animals, fighting each other ferociously.

This is a fight between instinct and instinct. The moves are strong and there is no dodge. Even if you succeed in killing the opponent, you will still be scarred.

The Zerg puppies only had a slight upper hand in the battle.

This unexpected encounter ended with both sides taking a step back after fighting each other to kill many troops.

The Zerg worker bees re-blocked the passage leading to the ghoul, leaving heavy troops to guard the nearby area.

Through an encounter, Wu Qing saw the strength displayed by the ghouls. Their individual combat power was almost comparable to that of Zerg puppies that had not upgraded their attack, defense, and speed. They were very powerful.

Moreover, the number of ghouls was very large, organized, and not affected by the lord's sanctuary area, which made Wu Qing feel threatened.

No matter what this ghoul is, and why it came, it has affected the development of the Zerg tribe, and it cannot be tolerated. Wu Qing wants to organize the Zerg tribe to take the initiative and clear out all the ghouls near the Zerg tribe's territory.

When plotting against others, one must also guard against others plotting against others. The appearance of ghouls may not be a coincidence.

The Zerg underground base, which originally did not have many defensive buildings, was quickly rebuilt. A large number of defensive spikes and a small number of air defense towers were distributed in an orderly manner, forming a solid defense system.

The defense effect of defensive ground thorns in the ground is very good. The purpose of air defense towers is mainly to detect lurking enemies. The real world is not a game. Air defense towers can also attack non-air enemies, but the attack effect is not as good as anti-air attacks.

Ghouls like to come out at night. In the past few nights, small groups of ghouls have continuously invaded the Zerg underground base. They have been warmly welcomed by the defensive spines and puppies, and have provided a lot of resources for the system.

Wu Qing decided to take the initiative. To solve the threat was one aspect, and for resources was another important reason. He found that the system resources provided by the ghoul were very large, and it was a good source of resource acquisition.

The Zerg have experimented with killing ordinary creatures in the wild, and the resources they can obtain are extremely limited. It would be more efficient to add some worker bees to mine.

The energy and luck of creatures in this world should be related to their strength and the forces they belong to. The stronger the strength and the stronger the forces they belong to, the more energy and luck they can provide.

It is rare to find a hostile race that can provide a lot of resources outside the evil god camp. Wu Qing naturally needs to manage it well.

…

Ghouls like to move at night. They are not afraid of weirdness, but the Zerg are not. The general weirdness is easy to deal with, but the fear is that there are unknown terrifying guys lurking outside.

Therefore, the Zerg at night are very honest. Except for testing the weirdness at the edge of the territory, they basically will not appear in the wild.

The Zerg army in Mengzhong City has basically withdrawn, and Wu Qing's Zerg clone has also returned. Everything is ready.

While the sun is high and it is still early, Wu Qing controls the clone and leads the Zerg army to the underground world.

This time, the Zerg troops gathered in the Zerg territory exceeded 60,000, including 6,000 Hydralisks. Except for the Zerg stationed in Mengzhong City, Daxia Territory and those performing various tasks outside, most of them returned to the Zerg territory.

A large number of Zergs burrowed into the ground, lurking and recovering, waiting for Wu Qing's call.

Wu Qing's Zerg clone led ten guards and 5,000 Zerg troops, and the first batch passed through the Zerg underground base and entered a huge ghoul passage.

It was pitch black inside, and Wu Qing's Zerg clone needed to rely on the Zerg's night vision ability and mental perception to observe the situation.

The Zerg troops consisted of 3,000 puppies and 2,000 Hydralisks, and several hosts also followed in through the tall cave passage.

This cave passage should be the main passage for the ghouls to the direction of the Zerg territory. It was dug very tall and spacious, and the host floated in the cave and could move freely.

Seeing the ghouls digging such a cave passage, Wu Qing became more cautious. These ghouls may not be of only one kind, and there may be larger guys.
